[Part 1](https://mapgenie.io/resident-evil-requiem/maps/world?locationIds=543159) | [Part 2](https://mapgenie.io/resident-evil-requiem/maps/world?locationIds=543160) | [Part 3](https://mapgenie.io/resident-evil-requiem/maps/world?locationIds=543157) | [Part 4](https://mapgenie.io/resident-evil-requiem/maps/world?locationIds=542152) | [Part 5](https://mapgenie.io/resident-evil-requiem/maps/world?locationIds=541736) | Part 6

G is the Sun - a sticker on the side of [this microscope](https://mapgenie.io/resident-evil-requiem/maps/world?locationIds=541024#L) says G = 15000000000, and the sun is around that distance from the earth.

C is Star - the [Grace Ashcroft Blood Analysis Report](https://mapgenie.io/resident-evil-requiem/maps/world?locationIds=541759#L) file mentions 'C = 4.2ly', and the closest star to Earth (Alpha Centauri) is around 4.2 light years away.

U is Moon - letting the sand trickle through the [hourglass](https://mapgenie.io/resident-evil-requiem/maps/world?locationIds=541742#L) reveals a message saying U = 380,000, the distance between Earth and the moon.

Part 4 told us to 'just ignore A', so when we translate the sequence, the code is:
- Sun, Sun, Star
- Sun, Moon, Star
- Sun, Moon, Sun
- Moon, Star, Moon

Enter the code into the [Sun Puzzle Box](https://mapgenie.io/resident-evil-requiem/maps/world?locationIds=541204) while holding Emily and [the doll from part 3](https://mapgenie.io/resident-evil-requiem/maps/world?locationIds=543157), and you'll hear a creepy laugh - the puzzle is now complete. Pretty stupid, huh?

locations.description:

locations.title: The Final Puzzle - Part 1
locations.description:
Part 1 | [Part 2](https://mapgenie.io/resident-evil-requiem/maps/world?locationIds=543160) | [Part 3](https://mapgenie.io/resident-evil-requiem/maps/world?locationIds=543157) | [Part 4](https://mapgenie.io/resident-evil-requiem/maps/world?locationIds=542152) | [Part 5](https://mapgenie.io/resident-evil-requiem/maps/world?locationIds=541736) | [Part 6](https://mapgenie.io/resident-evil-requiem/maps/world?locationIds=541737)

**Before** you drain the liquid, stand by the side of the pool for around 20 minutes. After that, drain the liquid, but **don't kill any zombies yourself** - let them all die to the grinder.

We're not 100% sure _why_ this is part of the solution, but the [Subject 170 Record](https://mapgenie.io/resident-evil-requiem/maps/world?locationIds=541757) mentions 115 infected being used to collect 524.3 litres of blood, and corpses are flowing into the pool here. 15-20 minutes is plenty of time to generate all that blood.
